title: cleistocalyx myrtoides
intro: Cleistocalyx myrtoides, commonly known as the Bay laurel or Malay tea tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as being used to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cleistocalyx myrtoides include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-hypertensive properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cleistocalyx myrtoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
